question: What dual result does the practitioner obtain through this ritual performance?
premises: The practitioner secures all desires here.
The practitioner reaches an end state.
Liberation is attained at the end.
inference: Having obtained all desires here, the practitioner also obtains liberation at the end.
uncertainties: Whether ante refers to the end of the rite or end of life is ambiguous.
plain_english: Having obtained all desires here, he also attains liberation in the end.
